direct_messages.text:
Hi! Saw you're looking for a security-sandbox evaluation partner that doesn't touch production.

We're building LTZZZ, a multi-AI agent-workflow prototype. In one recent Base test, an agent-to-agent outreach task was logged alongside a 1 USDC transfer; the transaction and task record are public. We're testing spend limits and auditable execution, not claiming every agent action is fully on-chain.

Curious what constraints you're evaluating—memory isolation, spend limits, or kill switches? Happy to compare notes if useful.

Hey — saw you're trying to turn messy founder notes into a plan with AI. That's the workflow we're building at LTZZZ.

Our multi-agent prototype turns daily logs into structured tasks and records outcomes; a recent Grok-to-Doubao outreach experiment has a public task record and a related Base transaction. It's early-stage, but we're learning what makes the handoff reliable.

What's your current notes stack—text, audio, or scattered across apps?
